_comment: Sources that Phase 3/4 of the frontend rebuild moved out of index.html: ES modules (former inline script) and stylesheets (former inline <style> blocks), in the order they appeared. Legacy source-slicing checks (scripts/, backend/tests) read these BEFORE index.html so a brace-matching extractor finds the real definition rather than the one-line delegating stub index.html keeps, and so CSS-rule assertions still see the rules. Maintained by hand with every move (docs/rebuild/STATUS.md). `pages` (Phase 5): for each other root page, the external classic scripts its inline logic moved into, in document order; checks that slice that page read them first, then the page.
